prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1364; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of low back pain and stiffness radiating into the left hip region. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces involved in a crash of this type, and the presenting symptoms align with a lumbar strain. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the lumbar paraspinal musculature, with documented restricted range of motion and localized tenderness. No prior complaints or treatment involving this body area are known from the patient history or available records. Over the course of care the patient completed 18 visits, a somewhat longer course than typically seen for this injury, consisting of manual therapy, supervised exercise, and home program instruction. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated charges. Patient has shown gradual improvement and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home exercise and periodic reassessment.
